name: Indou Eita
source:
Teru's senpai at the school.

He is the face of a group of delinquents and a force to be reckoned with, even by the teachers. He is exceptionally good at fighting.

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
